hunks.baseline: For someone born and raised in Gansu Province, the pale sandstorms that swept through in every season were nothing unusual.
hunks.sol: For anyone born and raised in Gansu Province, the pale sandstorms that swept through year-round were nothing unusual.

hunks.baseline: Since time immemorial, from the days when the river that flowed through the region came to be called the Yellow River, their ancestors had recorded the existence of the loess-colored plateau.
hunks.sol: Their ancestors had recorded the loess-colored plateau’s existence as far back as the days when the river flowing through the region came to be called the Yellow River.

hunks.baseline: No one knew exactly when it had formed or why, but the plateau was still there.
On days when a strong wind blew in from somewhere, it would sweep through the area like a waterspout, then vanish, scattering fine, soft loess like stars.
hunks.sol: No one knew exactly when the plateau had formed or why, but it was still there. Whenever a strong wind blew in, a cloud would rise like a waterspout and sweep across the area before vanishing, scattering fine loess like stars.

hunks.baseline: That was probably why.
The martial artists of the Black Dragon Demon Gate standing watch atop the city wall felt little as they watched a cloud of dust approach from the far north.
hunks.sol: That was probably why the Black Dragon Demon Gate martial artists standing watch atop the city wall felt nothing in particular as they watched a cloud of dust approach from the far north.

hunks.baseline: One of the martial artists frowned. The middle-aged man leading their squad pulled a scrap of cloth from inside his clothes with a practiced motion.
hunks.sol: One of the martial artists frowned. The middle-aged squad leader pulled a scrap of cloth from inside his clothes with a practiced motion.

hunks.baseline: “Shut your mouth and put on your mask. Don’t stubbornly stand there like last time, then spend the next few days complaining.”
hunks.sol: “Shut your mouth and put on your mask. Don’t stand there trying to tough it out like last time, then complain for days afterward.”

hunks.baseline: “No, I really couldn’t help it that time. How are you supposed to dodge when it hits you all at once? It takes your breath away.”
hunks.sol: “I really couldn’t help it that time. How are you supposed to dodge it when it hits all at once? You can’t even breathe.”

hunks.baseline: “Do whatever you want. If you’d rather eat a handful of sand than your next meal.”
hunks.sol: “Suit yourself. If you’d rather eat a handful of sand than your next meal.”

hunks.baseline: Just then, as chuckles rippled through the group, someone watching the cloud of dust spoke up.
hunks.sol: The others were chuckling when someone watching the cloud of dust spoke up.

hunks.baseline: “Still, what’s coming now is small and cute. Looks like it’ll die down on its own before it even gets here. The scouts way out front are going to get buried, though.”
hunks.sol: “Still, this one’s little. Almost cute. Looks like it’ll die down before it reaches us. The scouts way out front are going to get covered in it, though.”

hunks.baseline: They’d dealt with this more times than they could count. By now, they knew the drill.
It wasn’t a sandstorm towering more than ten jang high. There was no need to make such a fuss over a little cloud of dust.
hunks.sol: They’d been through this often enough to know what they were looking at. This wasn’t a sandstorm towering more than ten jang high. There was no need to make a fuss over a little cloud of dust.

hunks.baseline: Without even bothering to check for themselves, the martial artists teased their Captain, who’d put on his mask early.
hunks.sol: Without bothering to take another look, the martial artists teased the Captain for putting on his mask so early.

hunks.baseline: “The Blood-Death Sword title will be weeping. Heh.”
hunks.sol: “The Blood-Death Sword will be weeping. Heh.”

hunks.baseline: “Now, now. You can tell what it is at a glance. Why the rush? I used to be a mounted bandit when I was young, and I know a group of about thirty riders traveling side by side kicks up a cloud about that size. It’s nothing.”
hunks.sol: “Come on, you can tell how big it is at a glance. Why the rush? I used to be a mounted bandit, and I know thirty riders galloping side by side kick up a cloud about that size. It’s nothing.”

hunks.baseline: In that instant, the Captain’s already fearsome face twisted into something monstrous.
hunks.sol: The Captain’s already fearsome face twisted into something monstrous.

hunks.baseline: The laughter slowly died away.
His subordinates remembered that the Captain had once been fairly notorious in the area. They swallowed hard.
hunks.sol: The laughter slowly died. His subordinates remembered how notorious the Captain had once been in the area and swallowed hard.

hunks.baseline: “W-we didn’t mean it like that, Captain……”
hunks.sol: “W-we didn’t mean it like that, Captain…”

hunks.baseline: But at the Captain’s next words, the men who’d been on edge could only stare at him in confusion.
hunks.sol: But his next words left them staring at him in confusion.

hunks.baseline: “The last thing that guy said. What was it?”
hunks.sol: “The last thing he said. What was it?”

hunks.baseline: Everyone’s eyes turned toward the mounted bandit. He blinked.
hunks.sol: Everyone turned toward the former mounted bandit. He blinked.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. Say what you said before again.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Say that again.”

hunks.baseline: “Uh, well, you can tell what it is at a glance, so why the rush—”
hunks.sol: “Uh, you can tell how big it is at a glance, so why the rush—”

hunks.baseline: “Not that, you idiot! The next part!”
hunks.sol: “Not that, you bastard! The part after it!”

hunks.baseline: “Th-that a cloud of dust that size means about thirty mounted—”
hunks.sol: “Th-that a cloud of dust that size means about thirty riders…”

hunks.baseline: “Exactly thirty. Was that when they got their horses earlier? I remember because they made a huge fuss, demanding better mounts since they had to patrol until sunset……”
hunks.sol: “Exactly thirty. I remember because when we gave them their horses, they raised hell demanding better mounts for a patrol that would last until sunset…”

hunks.baseline: His voice cut off before he could finish.
hunks.sol: His voice cut off.

hunks.baseline: Only then did the martial artists realize something was wrong. Their eyes darted back and forth as they held an inaudible conversation among themselves.
hunks.sol: Only then did the martial artists realize something was wrong. Their eyes darted between one another as they carried on a silent conversation.

hunks.baseline: *An unusually small cloud of dust. Thirty mounted warriors. And, finally, thirty scouts.*
hunks.sol: *An unusually small cloud of dust. Thirty riders. And thirty scouts.*

hunks.baseline: *Why are they back already if they weren’t supposed to return until after sunset?*
hunks.sol: *Why are they back already if they’re not due until after sunset?*

hunks.baseline: *Maybe they had to take a dump?*
hunks.sol: *Maybe someone had to take a dump?*

hunks.baseline: *You can shit anywhere, cover it up, and call it a latrine. What kind of lunatic would abandon a mission just to come back and relieve himself?*
hunks.sol: *You can shit anywhere, cover it up, and call it a latrine. What kind of lunatic abandons a patrol to come back for that?*

hunks.baseline: *Isn’t that what everyone does? I do.*
hunks.sol: *Doesn’t everyone? I do.*

hunks.baseline: No matter how hard they thought, no matter how much they wracked their brains, something was clearly amiss.
hunks.sol: No matter how they put their heads together, no matter what explanation they came up with, something was clearly amiss.

hunks.baseline: In the strange tension, just as someone swallowed dryly—
hunks.sol: In the strange tension, someone swallowed dryly.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of jang away, red smoke shot up from the pale cloud of dust. The Captain recognized what the signal flare assigned to the scouts meant and forced his voice out.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of jang away, red smoke shot up from the pale cloud of dust. The Captain recognized the scouts’ signal flare and forced the words out.

hunks.baseline: “Suspicious persons spotted……!”
hunks.sol: “Suspicious person spotted…!”

hunks.baseline: Suspicious persons meant people acting strangely—in other words, unfamiliar intruders.
hunks.sol: That was the signal for someone acting strangely—an unfamiliar intruder.

hunks.baseline: At last realizing what was happening, the martial artists atop the wall shouted as if coughing up blood.
hunks.sol: The martial artists atop the wall finally grasped what was happening and shouted themselves hoarse.

hunks.baseline: “Real situation! This is real!”
hunks.sol: “This is real! It’s really happening!”

hunks.baseline: “What are you waiting for, you bastards? Move your asses!”
hunks.sol: “What are you waiting for, you bastards? Move!”

hunks.baseline: The wall erupted into chaos as if a powder magazine had exploded. Meanwhile, the flare that had burst brilliantly in the sky slowly drifted down over the thirty scouts racing toward them with all their might, raising a cloud of dust.
hunks.sol: The wall erupted into chaos as though a powder magazine had exploded. Above the thirty scouts racing toward it with all their might, kicking up dust, the flare that had burst so brilliantly in the sky began to drift down.

hunks.baseline: And on one of the dozens of hills, a group watched the scene with their backs to the shadows.
hunks.sol: On one of the dozens of winding hills, a group stood watching with the shadows at their backs.

hunks.baseline: “Well…… this is a hell of a mess.”
hunks.sol: “Well… this is a hell of a mess.”

hunks.baseline: About fifty mounted warriors of unknown identity stood there. At the front of the group, a giant let out a low groan. Beside him, another man scratched at his shaggy hair.
hunks.sol: There were about fifty unidentified riders. At their head, a giant of a man let out a low groan. Another man beside him scratched vigorously at his shaggy hair.

hunks.baseline: “I didn’t think they’d panic and run. We even brought a white flag just in case. Why are those bastards so scared?”
hunks.sol: “I didn’t think they’d panic and run. I even brought a white flag just in case. Why are those bastards so scared?”

hunks.baseline: “Do you really need to ask? Take a look at your own face, Big Brother. Do you think anyone’s going to take a white flag as a friendly gesture when you look like that?”
hunks.sol: “Do you really need to ask? Look at your face, Big Brother. Who’s going to take a white flag as a friendly gesture from someone who looks like you?”

hunks.baseline: At someone’s chiding, agreement erupted from all around them.
hunks.sol: Agreement erupted from all around them.

hunks.baseline: “It wouldn’t have helped if you’d gone over wearing white clothes instead of carrying a white flag.”
hunks.sol: “It wouldn’t have helped if you’d gone over dressed in white instead.”

hunks.baseline: “Then they’d think you’d dressed in mourning ahead of time to offer your condolences to the poor bastards about to die.”
hunks.sol: “Then they’d think you’d put on mourning clothes in advance to offer your condolences to the poor bastards about to die.”

hunks.baseline: “Nothing to be done. Even the Heavenly Demon’s granddaddy couldn’t beat Big Brother when it comes to looking vicious.”
hunks.sol: “No need to say another word. Not even the Heavenly Demon’s granddaddy could beat Big Brother at looking vicious.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. This whole situation’s going to shit, and now I’m starting to get nervous. What if we ride over there and they shower us with arrows?”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. This whole thing’s going to shit, and now I’m getting nervous. What if we ride over there and they shower us with arrows?”

hunks.baseline: “Can’t be helped. Big Brother, since it’s come to this, let’s just turn around and go back.”
hunks.sol: “Can’t be helped. Big Brother, since it’s come to this, let’s turn around while we still can.”

hunks.baseline: “Enough! Who’s scared? I just remembered I left something important behind!”
hunks.sol: “Bah! Who’s scared? I just remembered I left something important behind!”

hunks.baseline: “Looks like you brought your shriveled-up guts along just fine…… Ah, you left your balls behind.”
hunks.sol: “Looks like you brought your shriveled-up guts along… Ah, you left your balls behind.”

hunks.baseline: “Enough! Third Brother, how dare you!”
hunks.sol: “Bah! Third Brother, how dare you!”

hunks.baseline: “Honestly, you keep going on like that. It’s only cool when a Supreme Peak master does it. You can’t pull it off, Second Brother.”
hunks.sol: “There you go again with the *bah, bah*. That only sounds impressive when a Supreme Peak master says it. You can’t pull it off, Second Brother.”

hunks.baseline: “Enough! Do you have to see your own coffin before you learn your lesson?”
hunks.sol: “Bah! Must you see your own coffin before you learn your lesson?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m going to lose my mind if I have to keep listening to that. You’ve picked up a weird habit. So, Big Brother, what are you going to do?”
hunks.sol: “I’m going to lose my mind if I have to keep hearing that. What a weird habit to pick up. So, Big Brother, what are we going to do?”

hunks.baseline: At the question from the man called Third Brother, the giant, who’d kept silent even as voices flew back and forth, finally spoke.
hunks.sol: At the question from the man called Third Brother, the giant, who’d stayed silent through the rapid-fire exchange, finally spoke.

hunks.baseline: His voice was as heavy as his build. With a steady gaze, the giant stared at the loess-colored wall standing tall beyond the shimmering heat.
hunks.sol: His voice was as heavy as his build. He fixed his gaze on the loess-colored wall rising beyond the heat haze.

hunks.baseline: “I know what you’re all worried about…… But this is a personal request from the Great One. If you’re men who understand loyalty, do as I say.”
hunks.sol: “I know what you’re all worried about… But Great Sir asked this of us himself. If you’re men who understand loyalty, follow my lead.”

hunks.baseline: At the giant’s stern words, the eyes of the six men who called him Big Brother trembled.
hunks.sol: The six men who called him Big Brother stared at him, their eyes trembling at his stern words.

hunks.baseline: Of course, the mutters that followed weren’t the reaction the giant had hoped for.
hunks.sol: The mutters that followed, however, weren’t the reaction he’d hoped for.

hunks.baseline: “He’s a bear in name only. He turns into a fox whenever it suits him. Am I right, brothers?”
hunks.sol: “He’s a bear until it suits him to be a fox. Am I right, brothers?”

hunks.baseline: “Still, we should all do as Big Brother says. Besides, this request came from the Great One himself. What choice do we have?”
hunks.sol: “Still, we should do as Big Brother says. Besides, Great Sir himself asked us. What choice do we have?”

hunks.baseline: “Enough……”
hunks.sol: “Bah…!”

hunks.baseline: “Please, someone gag Second Brother. Listening to him is giving me qi deviation.”
hunks.sol: “Please, someone gag Second Brother. Listening to him is going to give me qi deviation.”

hunks.baseline: Most of them grumbled like children who’d had their sweets taken away. But the giant—and the dozens of mounted warriors watching from behind him—knew the truth.
hunks.sol: Most of them grumbled like children whose sweets had been taken away. But they knew, as did the giant and the dozens of riders watching from behind them, that their purpose hadn’t changed just because things had turned out this way.

hunks.baseline: Even though things had turned out this way, their purpose hadn’t changed.
And the strongest proof of that conviction was the person who’d sent them here.
hunks.sol: The strongest reason for that certainty was the person who had sent them here.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s go. The sun’s going to set at this rate.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s go. The sun’ll set at this rate.”

hunks.baseline: Bathed in the sunset spreading late from the west, the fifty or so mounted warriors set off over the hill, led by the giant.
hunks.sol: With the late sunset beginning to spread from the west, the giant led the fifty or so riders over the hill.

hunks.baseline: Before long, they reached the wall. Waiting for them were hundreds of arrowheads trained on them, and unfamiliar faces visible between the shafts.
hunks.sol: Before long, they reached the wall. Hundreds of arrowheads were trained on them, with unfamiliar faces visible between them.

hunks.baseline: At the shout from some young pretty boy, the giant calmly reached into his clothes to pull out the white flag he’d prepared.
hunks.sol: At the shout from some young pretty boy, the giant calmly reached inside his clothes for the white flag he’d prepared.

hunks.baseline: Or rather, he tried to pull it out.
hunks.sol: Or rather, he tried to.

hunks.baseline: He didn’t get the chance—not before that young man issued a command he hadn’t expected.
hunks.sol: Before he could pull it out, the young man gave an order he hadn’t expected.
“…Huh?”

hunks.baseline: Their strength varied, but large or small, once they were imbued with internal energy, they plunged down in straight lines instead of arcs.
hunks.sol: Some carried more force than others, but every arrow, large or small, had been imbued with internal energy. Instead of arcing, they plunged straight down at the unexpected visitors.

hunks.baseline: Straight at the unexpected visitors.
Sparks flew in all directions.
hunks.sol: Sparks flew in every direction.

hunks.baseline: The giant stood ahead of his dozens of subordinates, alone. Having survived the net of arrows that had densely covered a thirty-jang radius, he bellowed.
hunks.sol: The giant had ridden ahead alone, leaving his dozens of subordinates behind. He survived the net of arrows that covered a thirty-jang radius and bellowed.

hunks.baseline: “He looks vicious as hell, but I can’t help agreeing with him. Have you been seized by a mind demon or something?”
hunks.sol: “He looks vicious as hell, but this old man has to agree with him. Has some inner demon taken hold of you?”

hunks.baseline: “I told him to put his hands up, and he didn’t listen. That bastard tried to pull a fast one on me.”
hunks.sol: “I told him to put his hands up, and he didn’t listen. That bastard tried to pull a fast one.”

hunks.baseline: “Honestly, I didn’t think they’d really shoot. I thought they’d ignore my order. Judging by their level, though, I figured they’d survive a volley like that, so I did it as a warning. Anyway, no harm done, right?”
hunks.sol: “Honestly, I didn’t think they’d actually shoot. I thought they’d ignore my order. Judging by his level, though, I figured he’d survive a volley like that, so it was a warning too. Anyway, no harm done, right?”

hunks.baseline: “Infinite Life Buddha……”
hunks.sol: “Infinite Life Buddha…”

hunks.baseline: The Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord muttered, looking appalled at my airtight conclusion. Unlike him, the Black Night King Sima Gong let out a hearty laugh.
hunks.sol: The Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord looked appalled by my clear-cut conclusion. The Black Night King, Sima Gong, burst into hearty laughter instead.

hunks.baseline: “Haha! Straight to the point. We could’ve used someone like you on our side.”
hunks.sol: “Haha! I like how you handle things. We could’ve used someone like you on our side.”

hunks.baseline: While I was trying to decide how to respond, the giant, whose face was so vicious it was hard to believe anyone could actually look that way, shouted again.
hunks.sol: While I considered how to respond, the giant—whose face was so vicious I could hardly believe anyone could look like that—shouted again.

hunks.baseline: So that was what he’d reached into his clothes for. What the giant was waving around was a large piece of cloth.
hunks.sol: So that was why he’d reached inside his clothes. He was waving a large piece of cloth.

hunks.baseline: A questionable shade of yellow, completely covered in sand and loess.
hunks.sol: It was covered in sand and loess, leaving it a thoroughly ambiguous yellowish color.

hunks.baseline: “What on earth is that supposed to mean? Why’s he waving around that dingy yellow thing?”
hunks.sol: “What on earth is that supposed to mean? What does he want us to see on that dingy yellow thing?”

hunks.baseline: “Yellow cloth…… Wait, could he be a Yellow Turban?”
hunks.sol: “Yellow cloth… Wait, could he be a Yellow Turban?”

hunks.baseline: “That makes no sense. What era do you think this is? How could the Yellow Turbans still be around?”
hunks.sol: “That’s ridiculous. What era do you think this is? How could the Yellow Turbans still be around?”

hunks.baseline: At the sight of everyone debating, I felt the weighty responsibility of having to offer another clear-cut answer.
hunks.sol: Watching everyone debate, I felt the weighty responsibility of providing another clear-cut answer.

hunks.baseline: *A suspicious-looking guy with a vicious face. And the others with him look like they’ve each got at least eighteen prior convictions.*
hunks.sol: *He’s acting suspicious, he looks vicious, and the men with him look like they’ve each got at least eighteen prior convictions.*

hunks.baseline: No matter how I looked at it, there was only one solution that came to mind.
hunks.sol: No matter how I looked at it, only one solution came to mind.
